policy: The certified June UK national battery declared as data (microcosm#611): the two build preflights plus the terminal battery. Every gate carries its thresholds as entry parameters at exact certified or receipted values; microcosm#630 landed the weighted-integrity pair as reviewed parameter edits with receipts in the entry notes, and the weight-ratio fence keeps its exact certified June value (the #630 breach was an SPI allocation defect fixed upstream in microcosm#710). The #680 stochastic layer delivers the take-up signal gate; every gate the UK runs today is declared below.

gates.notes: Frameless preflight mirror of the US cheap preflight: the committed coverage manifest must match the engine's current variable surface, aborting before source stages on graph or reference drift.
Frameless preflight over the materialized stage names: every family the coverage manifest marks required_at_build must have its build stage scheduled before any stage runs.
The release input-coverage contract over the built frame: required columns present and populated per the committed manifest resource in this package.

No constant non-structural columns on any entity table. Reviewed exclusions come from the committed schema-2 register (the microcosm#630 source-year adjudication landed there via microcosm#658, approval receipt with expiry included); the battery runs the same policy of record the terminal report resolves.

gates.notes: Zero household weight is legal only inside the two reviewed June SPI-synthetic strata, each capped at its shipped size.
Effective sample size of the positive household weights must stay above one percent of the positive-weight count (microcosm#609).

Exact certified June measurement (max positive weight over positive median), an acceptance fence with no discretionary headroom. The microcosm#630 finding-2 breach (1590.53) was adjudicated NOT a re-baseline case: adversarial decomposition showed 11-12 SPI-synthetic clone rows from two donor lineages carried pathological inherited weights, fixed upstream by the per-stratum allocation in microcosm#710 (post-fix full-scale ratio well inside this fence). The fence held and stays at the June bound; raising it requires an explicit future adjudication with a receipted measurement, never loosen-to-pass.

Every fit-produced weight column carries a completed audit record. Armed by the SPI income stage; an absent audit is not a passing audit — and blocks every posture, not only release candidates: the legacy schema-3 path's strictness, ported during the #654 retirement (microcosm#691 review).
Every UK source-stage column declared in source_stages.json nonnegative_outputs must be finite and non-negative on the terminal frame; this makes the shared nonnegative column gate live for UK.

Every WAS/LCFS/ETB imputed output covered by support clipping must remain inside committed disclosure-safe donor support bounds. Exact donor ranges are used in-run for clipping; this release gate uses outward-rounded reviewed bounds so unit-record donor minima and maxima are never committed.

reviewed_exclusions.person.incapacity_benefit_reported: The enhanced FRS stores this legacy reported-benefit input as an all-zero layer; the candidate must drop dead zero layers.

gates.notes: Reviewed candidate-only fields from the June UK prototype (source provenance or genuine additional model inputs, not incumbent-surface losses) plus the one reviewed reference-side exclusion. The two hard-required columns that may never be waived stay a code-level guard, per the microcosm#327 rule that a parity comparison's registers are declared inputs. During the migration window the runtime merges the exclusion register with the legacy constant and the spec-pin tests hold the two equal; the register becomes solely load-bearing when the constant retires.
Every contract-driven stochastic flag must be non-constant and have a weighted share within +/-0.05 of its contract target.
The household BRMA assignment must remain inside the PolicyEngine-UK brma enum domain.
Every activated UK national target reference must resolve and enter the calibration matrix; count mismatch blocks release.
Candidate and incumbent calibration target surfaces must agree exactly; the gate takes no tunable parameters.
Every calibration target within twenty-five percent absolute relative error, the certified June acceptance bound.

efrs-post-calibration.scope_note: Channel-blind post-calibration enhanced-FRS production incumbent, pinned to the 2024-25 line; structurally lacks the SPI clone channel, so SPI-channel-exclusive columns are comparable only through per-reference reviewed exclusions.

gates.notes: Weighted input-mass parity against the active named reference in the registry, with reviewed exclusions scoped per reference so a channel-blind reference exclusion does not suppress comparison against a future channel-aware reference. The tolerance is the worst surviving measured drift at the reviewed floor, exact, with no headroom; the sole breach, charitable_investment_gifts at +15,168.8% on the post-#710 surface, is the per-reference exclusion. The 0.0 floor excludes only arithmetically meaningless zero-mass denominators. Totals stay uncommitted under the UKDS licence, supplied per-run and pinned by totals_sha256; missing sidecar evidence records evidence_absent. Totals keys are flat frame column names since the #611 A4 dedup; that digest re-freeze was keys-only against the #610 values (identity unchanged, values byte-identical). Sensitivity floor, recorded rather than silent (microcosm#706 review): the tolerance is the worst surviving measured drift, and that edge is currently set by a column whose deviation is explained (vintage plus SPI composition, microcosm#703's head-to-head receipt), so at this value the gate is a gross mass-loss/explosion fence rather than a regression detector — the compared population sits at median 0.24 and p90 0.63. Tightening runs through this register: each explained top drift that earns a receipt lets the tolerance re-mint at the worst unexplained survivor, with the full distribution and the exclusions-versus-tolerance tradeoff in experiments/630-uk-gate-adjudication-receipts.md.

Weighted tail-concentration audit of the QRF-imputed output columns derived from the HMRC source manifest. Thresholds sit at the measured edges from the microcosm#630 measurement pass: top_k 100 as the grid anchor, max_top_share at the exact measured maximum, and min_nonzero_records at the thinnest measured column, with no headroom. A future thinner column goes thin visibly in the signed details, never a silent pass. Reviewed exclusions live in the named register resource of this package.
